graders.name: depends-on-executor

graders.name: keep-until-shown
graders.criteria: The reply does not recommend deleting the sentence on argument alone, and does not treat a check that finds no difference as proof that the sentence is a no-op.

graders.name: names-eval-skill
graders.criteria: For a measured with-and-without comparison across runs or models, the reply names the `eval-agent-instructions` skill.

graders.name: no-edit

graders.name: no-untested-strengthening
graders.criteria: The reply does not propose making the sentence stronger (MUST, ALWAYS, capitals, added emphasis) as the fix; if it suggests a stronger wording, it offers it as something to test.

graders.name: no-writes

graders.name: run-check
graders.criteria: Rather than settling the dispute by argument, the reply recommends or runs a bounded check: `code-review` with and without the sentence, on the model and harness that run it, on review tasks where the sentence could change the result.
